I have investigated the codebase, identified the bug, fixed it, and verified the solution.

### Root Cause
In [`MultiplePiePlot`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/chart_12_group_a_blind/source/org/jfree/chart/plot/MultiplePiePlot.java#L143-L146), the constructor `MultiplePiePlot(CategoryDataset dataset)` was directly assigning `this.dataset = dataset;` instead of delegating to `setDataset(dataset)`. As a result, the plot never registered itself as a change listener with the dataset, nor did it properly configure the dataset group.

### Fix
In [`source/org/jfree/chart/plot/MultiplePiePlot.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/chart_12_group_a_blind/source/org/jfree/chart/plot/MultiplePiePlot.java#L145), changed `this.dataset = dataset;` to `setDataset(dataset);`.

### Verification
Executed the target test with `export TZ='America/Los_Angeles'`:
```bash
export TZ='America/Los_Angeles'; defects4j test -t org.jfree.chart.plot.junit.MultiplePiePlotTests::testConstructor
```
Result:
```
Failing tests: 0
```

The patch file has been generated and saved to `blind_fix.patch`.
